Export exact selected original vertex positions/triangles/corner ownership/UVs/normals/materialIDs/three named fields. Scan every target vertex, target triangle centroid and target edge midpoint against dense source; then every source vertex and source triangle centroid against target. Write edge-midpoint scan before source reverse scans.
